item.name: Match a recorded route to the road network.

request.name: Match a recorded route to the road network.

description.content: The map matching API transforms a recorded route into navigation instructions like you would get from the `route` endpoint. The input can be in the form of either an encoded polyline, or (optionally) timestamped coordinates.

response.name: The matched route(s), which looks more or less like a normal route response, optionally with a `linear_references` key.
Bad request; more details will be included
An internal parse error occurred; more details will be included
